definitions.explanation: An established political, social, or organizational structure or framework.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{体制|たいせい}を{作|つく}る。
examples.english: We will create a new system.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}の{管理|かんり}{体制|たいせい}を{見直|みなお}す。
examples.english: We will review the company's management structure.

examples.japanese: {政治|せいじ}{体制|たいせい}が{変|か}わった。

notes:
{体制|たいせい} refers to established systems, especially political or organizational structures.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {体制|たいせい}を{整|ととの}える: to establish a system
- {管理|かんり}{体制|たいせい}: management system
- {政治|せいじ}{体制|たいせい}: political system
- {支援|しえん}{体制|たいせい}: support structure
- {体制|たいせい}{側|がわ}: the establishment

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {体系|たいけい}: system (of knowledge/theory)
- {制度|せいど}: system, institution
- {組織|そしき}: organization

[Register: Formal]
